test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

K _T G B _L T G _ K L _ G B K L T _B
solution:
Given :- K _T G B _L T G _ K L _ G B K L T _B

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) L, K, B, T, G → K **L** T G B - **K** L T G **B** - K L **T** G B - K L T **G** B

2) L, B, K, T, G → K **L** T G B - **B** L T G **K** - K L **T** G B - K L T **G** B

3) L, K, B, G, T → K **L** T G B - **K** L T G **B** - K L **G** G B - K L T **T** B

4) L, B, K, G, T → K **L** T G B - **B** L T G **K** - K L **G** G B - K L T **T** B

 
• Option (1) gives the pattern of :- K L T G B - K L T G B - K L T G B - K L T G B

Hence, the correct answer is **"L, K, B, T, G".**
